lines.beaver: 다음 달 선거 있잖아요. 후보들 봤어요?
lines.beaver_en: There's an election next month. Have you seen the candidates?
lines.beaver_roman: Daeum dal seongeo itjanayo. Hubodeul bwasseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 봤어요. 후보가 다섯 명이라 고민이에요.
lines.en: Yes, I have. There are five candidates, so it's hard to choose.
lines.roman: Ne, bwasseoyo. Huboga daseon myeongira gominieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Whose policies do you like best?
lines.learner: 남북 평화 정책이 좋아서 마음이 가요.
lines.en: I like the inter-Korean peace policy, so I lean that way.
lines.roman: Nambuk pyeonghwa jeongchaegi joaseo maeumi gayo.

lines.learner: 맞아요. 평화가 중요하다는 건 다 알죠.
lines.en: Right. Everyone knows peace is important.
lines.roman: Majayo. Pyeonghwaga jungyohadaneun geon da aljyo.

lines.beaver: 정부 개혁 이야기도 많던데, 개혁은 가능할까요?
lines.beaver_en: There's a lot of talk about government reform. Is reform possible?
lines.beaver_roman: Jeongbu gaehyeok iyagido manteonde, gaehyeogeun ganeunghalkkayo?
lines.learner: 쉽지 않지만 정부 개혁이 필요함은 분명해요.
lines.en: It's not easy, but government reform is clearly needed.
lines.roman: Swipji anchiman jeongbu gaehyeogi piryohameun bunmyeonghaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: What about the politicians? Can we trust them?
lines.learner: 권력을 가진 정치인은 책임도 커야 해요.
lines.en: Politicians with power should also have great responsibility.
lines.roman: Gwollyeogeul gajin jeongchiineun chaegimdo keoya haeyo.

lines.learner: 좋은 지도자는 국민의 말을 잘 들어요.
lines.en: A good leader listens well to the people.
lines.roman: Joeun jidojaneun gungmine mareul jal deureoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What do you think of the conservative candidate?
lines.en: I admit the conservative candidate has strengths too.

lines.beaver_en: I heard that candidate used to be an ambassador.
lines.en: Since he was an ambassador, he'll probably be good at diplomacy.

lines.beaver: 정치와 선거에 대해 더 이야기해 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Want to talk more about politics and elections?
lines.beaver_roman: Jeongchiwa seongeoe daehae deo iyagihae bollaeyo?
lines.en: Of course. Voting is where democracy begins, after all.

lines.beaver_en: Right. Let's definitely vote together that day.
lines.learner: 네, 선거 날 점심 먹고 같이 가요!
lines.en: Sure, let's go together after lunch on election day!
lines.roman: Ne, seongeo nal jeomsim meokgo gachi gayo!
